topic: decimal-safe paise rounding for budget amounts
lesson: In mis-budget.parser.ts round monetary values to paise with decimal-safe, symmetric semantics - Math.round(value*100) rounds half-up and mishandles negative half-paise and binary float drift. Use a decimal-safe rounder (round-half-away-from-zero on the scaled value with an epsilon, matching the actuals numeric path) so budget/rollover amounts are exact at paise.
